in_hebrew.name: נאיע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word נאא (na'a) meaning 'to be gracious, to be merciful' and the suffix יה (yah) which is a common suffix meaning 'of God'.

in_greek.name: Ναία
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word νάος (naos) which means 'ship, boat' and the suffix α (a) which changes the meaning to 'nurse' or 'nymph'.

in_latin.name: Naia
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word natus which means 'born' and the suffix ianus which means 'god of the gates, god of the home'.
